notes: No published 4-year plan exists for this concentration: only the seven BSOS/CMNS concentrations have an official AGNR-hosted PDF plan. This plan is CONSTRUCTED from the catalog's own requirement rows instead (docs/project/owner-review.md flags this). Gen Ed courses are left out; only the major is audited.
Applied Science and Policy filled with ENSP330; Calculus filled with MATH140; Statistics filled with GEOG306.
'Four of five groups' filled with: Biology (BSCI160 & BSCI180), Chemistry (CHEM131 & CHEM132), Earth Sciences (ENST200), Geography (GEOG130).

Economics Foundation filled with Track 2 only (ECON201, ECON230, AREC326, and MATH121 for the 'select one' line); Track 1's courses (MATH141, ECON321/STAT400, standalone ECON326) are deliberately absent so the plan exercises exactly one branch of the `sets` choice.

The two Restricted Electives blocks (inside and outside Economics) are not in this plan because they are not encoded in the Program (see reviewNotes and docs/project/owner-review.md): the catalog names no course, department or area-specific course for either block.
